tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje gtsug lag gi gtor 'bul bzhugs so//

gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ rakta bran/ dgug gzhug bya/ sman raka byin rlabs gtor bsngos byas la/ hūm̐ */ dur khrod rab 'jigs rngam pa'i pho brang nas// nyi zla padma 'bar ba'i gdan gyi steng*// dpal chen khro rgyal stobs ldan nag po che// gnyis med yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag /gnas lngar bya khyung rta mgrin rdo rje gzhon// phyag na rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed po bzhugs// khyab 'jug chen po dregs pa kun gyi gtso| |srog len nag po gsod byed khrag 'thung ma// las mkhan sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa gsum// 'chi bdag gshin rje srog gi bdag mo dang*// ma hā de wa mu stegs yaksha nag /me yi kha rlangs bdud mo khrag 'dzag ma// raksha glog phreng sbal mgo khrag mig ma// rā hu la dang gnod sbyin gang ba bzang*// sha za ral can rgyal po le byin har// dmu rje btsan pa btsan rgod yam shud dmar// dge bsnyen rdor legs 'gong po lag dgu dang*// rkang lag ring mo gzhon nu gtum mo rnams// rang rang 'khor bcas 'di gshegs gdan la bzhugs| |phyi nang gsang mchod sha khrag snying sna'i tshogs// sman raka gtor ma spyan gzigs dkor nor bcas// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched dang*// dbang po rnam lnga 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs// stobs ldan sngags bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la dam skong nyams chag bshags// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// bdag gi bsam don 'bad med 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma khang thog tu 'bul ba ni drag las sogs min pa'i dus gtor dang gsol mchod sogs kyi skabs bya/ yang dregs pa'i bsnyen sgrub byed tshe'ang thun drug gam bzhir gtor 'bul lam/ gtor mar sha zan sman raka bsgron la dgug gzhug gtor bsngos byas la gtor 'bul 'di bya ba yin no// //maṅga laṃ//
